remarks: Welcome to 10 Burritt Avenue, a charming and well-maintained two-family home in the heart of SONO - South Norwalk, lovingly cared for by the same family for over 52 years. This exceptional property offers a wonderful opportunity for owner-occupants or investors alike, with a prime location close to shopping, restaurants, the SONO Collection Mall, Veteran's Memorial Park and Marina, and the train station. Enjoy easy access to major highways, public transportation, and nearby beach access, making this a truly convenient coastal lifestyle. Unit 1, originally a two-bedroom, has been thoughtfully reconfigured into a spacious one-bedroom to provide additional living space for Unit 2-easily convertible back to two bedrooms if desired. Unit 2 spans the second and third floors and features three bedrooms and ample natural light throughout. The basement includes laundry facilities and plenty of storage. Recent updates include a newer roof, siding, windows, furnace and hot water heaters, ensuring peace of mind for years to come. Relax on the lovely wrap-around front porch overlooking the brand-new park just across the street. An oversized two-car detached garage and large driveway offer abundant parking and versatility. Experience the best of SONO living-comfort, character, and convenience-all in one special home at 10 Burritt Avenue.
